mission: Inventory all historical accepted Pact of Negation casts and determine whether actual payment/decision occurs at the original player's next upkeep, distinguishing stack/trigger description text from actual debt mechanics. No policy changes and no new full games.
sample_rule: All ten completed R1/R6 original frozen Control/A games, all four seats, all Pact of Negation CastSpell actions. No hand selection, seed exclusion, or event omission.

published_source_code.oracle: Counter target spell. At the beginning of your next upkeep, pay {3}{U}{U}. If you don't, you lose the game.

method: Pin and independently hash original ZIP archives and verify original SHA, accepted action and result streams, no error/rejection, and the original R5 comparator and skipped-mulligan initializer.

For each Pact CastSpell, identify the exact caster/card entity, cast action and turn, SpellCastEvent, distinct trigger AbilityTriggeredEvent, the first subsequent TurnChangedEvent naming that caster, the actual Pact YesNoResponse / DecisionSubmittedEvent and 3UU mana payment.

Classify proper next-upkeep payment only when a recorded YES decision and five-mana payment with at least two blue occur on the first subsequent own upkeep. Never infer unobserved capacity before the debt or future opponent behavior.

Record the printed textual description on the trigger, including any reference to End Step, separately from the actual phase/step at payment. Do not automatically classify a description discrepancy as a wrong gameplay loss or broken rules engine.
Report potential missing/extra triggers, debt prompts, payments, losses, or archive truncation, without silently excluding cases.

qualifier.safe_conclusion: If 13/13 are source-linked correctly, classify the text mismatch as an event-description or scheduling-inspection lead, not a demonstrated missed debt payment. A separate exact engine scenario is needed to locate any actual timing bug.
